LESSON: FINANCIAL SERVICES

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
Strand: Entrepreneurship
Topic 5.1: Financial Services

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Financial Services. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Financial Services
2. Practise Financial Services at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Financial Services

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Financial Services
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Financial Services. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Financial Services at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Financial Services at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Financial Services
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Financial Services. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Financial Services using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Financial Services in the examples.
2. Explain Financial Services to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Financial Services.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Financial Services using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Financial Services important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Financial Services
2. Practise Financial Services at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Financial Services

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
